block_info.label: Cholesky
block_info.description: Cholesky decomposition block targeted for AI Engines.

parameters.name: data_type
parameters.description: Type of idividual data samples of the input matrix
parameters.label: Input data type:

parameters.name: dim_matrix
parameters.description: Length of one dimension of the matrix.
parameters.label: Length of matrix dimension:

parameters.name: grid_dimension
parameters.description: Length of one dimension of the tiling scheme used to divide up the input matrix. This allows support for larger matrices than can fit on a single kernel.
parameters.label: Length of tile dimension:

parameters.name: num_frames
parameters.description: Number of matrices to decompose per call to the kernel.
parameters.label: Number of frames:

parameters.name: casc_length
parameters.description: Number of kernels to be used to split up and cascade the workload.
parameters.label: Number of cascade stages:

parameters.name: inversion_diag
parameters.description: A specialization of the Cholesky which eliminates redundant calculations when used in series with the Substiution core (inversion_diag set to 0).
parameters.label: Provide diagonal elements inverse
